preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence b is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i < 2**60 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence b is between 1 and 2^60 - 1.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' or starts with 'Yes\n'.
If the output is not 'No', the second line contains exactly n integers.
The unordered multiset of b and the unordered multiset of the permuted b' are equal.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'No' or all(int(b'_i') > int(b'_j') for b'_i', b'_j' in zip(return_value.split('\n')[1].split(), return_value.split('\n')[1].split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The sequence a_i = b'_1 ⊕ ... ⊕ b'_i is strictly increasing.
